opportunities.name: KAYAK hotel (Stays) search with guests, filters and sort
opportunities.description: On KAYAK Stays, search hotels for a {destination} from {check_in} to {check_out} with {rooms}/{adults}/{children (ages)}, then apply optional filters ({hotel_class}, {review_score}, {amenities}, {style}) and sort the results (e.g. price low to high).
steps: Open kayak.com and click 'Stays' in the left nav
Type the destination into 'Enter a city, hotel, airport, address or landmark' and pick the matching suggestion
Open the check-in date picker and click the check-in date (use the arrows to change month if needed)
Click the check-out date
Open the guests selector; set Rooms, Adults and Children with +/- (set each child's age if asked)
Click the orange search button (or 'Update' on the results page)
On the results page, apply any filters: hotel class stars, review score, amenities (e.g. free internet, air-conditioned), style (e.g. Family)
Open 'Sorted by' and pick the sort order, e.g. 'Price (low to high)'

instances.values: Le Marais, Paris, France; Mar 27 – Apr 2; 2 rooms, 3 adults; sorted by price (low to high)
Santa Fe, New Mexico; Jun 16 – Jun 18; 2 rooms, 3 adults
Kashi Vishwanath Temple, Varanasi; Jun 6 – Jun 10; 2 rooms, 3 adults + 1 child (age 7); filters: review 8+, 3-star+, free internet, Family style, air-conditioned; sorted by price (low to high)
Los Angeles, CA; May 21 – May 23; 1 room, 2 adults; 5-star filter

opportunities.name: Qatar Airways flight search and fare selection
opportunities.description: On qatarairways.com (Flights or Qatar Stopover tab), search one-way flights from {origin} to {destination} on {date} for {adults}/{children}/{infants} in {cabin_class}, then pick the flight and a fare tier.
steps: Open qatarairways.com, go to the Book widget and choose 'Flights' or 'Qatar Stopover'
Click 'From' and type the origin, then choose the airport suggestion
Click 'To' and type the destination, then choose the airport suggestion
Set Trip to 'One way'
Open Depart, click the travel date, then click Continue
Open Passengers/Class; set Adults, Child and Infant with +/-; choose the cabin (Economy or Premium); click Confirm
Click 'Show flights'
On the results page, click the fare box for the chosen flight and cabin
Click 'Select fare' on the chosen fare tier (e.g. Business Comfort or Economy Comfort); repeat for the return or connecting leg if one is shown

instances.values: Qatar Stopover; Colombo CMB → New York JFK; one way, 24 Jun 2023; 2 adults + 1 child; Premium (Business); Business Comfort selected on both legs (an IGN Store visit happened partway through)
Flights (from the Durban destination page); Doha DOH → Durban DUR; one way, 28 May 2023; 2 adults + 1 infant; Economy; Economy Comfort selected

opportunities.name: Qatar Airways hotel search (Booking.com partner)
opportunities.description: Starting from Qatar Airways Book > Hotel, search the Booking.com partner site for {destination} from {check_in} to {check_out} with {adults}/{rooms}, then apply filters, sort or reserve a property.
steps: On qatarairways.com, open the 'Book' menu and click 'Hotel'
On the Booking.com partner page, type the destination into 'Where are you going?' and pick the suggestion
Open the dates picker; click the check-in date and the check-out date (or a ± days option)
Click Search
On the results page, adjust adults/children/rooms in the sidebar and click Done
Apply filters (e.g. neighbourhood, Free WiFi, star rating) or open 'Sort by' and choose 'Price (lowest first)'
Optionally click 'See availability' on a property, then click 'Reserve'

instances.values: Las Vegas, Nevada; Apr 10 – Apr 16, 2023; 2 adults, 1 room; sorted by price (lowest first)
Washington, DC; Jun 5 – Jun 6, 2023; 4 adults, 2 rooms; filters: Downtown DC, Free WiFi, 5 stars; opened The St. Regis Washington, D.C. and clicked Reserve
